nodes.description: A broad module containing 4-5 concepts.
A minimal testable concept.

edges.description: Indicates that one concept or topic is a prerequisite for another. Must form a DAG.

nodes.name: Vectors and Linear Combinations
nodes.description: Addition, scalar multiplication, dot products, and linear combinations of vectors.

nodes.name: Elimination with Matrices
nodes.description: Solving systems of linear equations using Gaussian elimination, pivot variables, and multipliers.

nodes.name: Matrix Operations and Inverses
nodes.description: Rules for matrix multiplication, properties of operations, and computing the inverse of a matrix.

nodes.name: LU Factorization
nodes.description: Factoring a matrix into lower triangular (L) and upper triangular (U) components.

nodes.name: Vector Spaces and Subspaces
nodes.description: Definition of vector spaces and subspaces, closure under addition and scalar multiplication.

nodes.name: Null Space and Column Space
nodes.description: Understanding the null space (solutions to Ax=0) and column space (combinations of columns).

nodes.name: Linear Independence, Basis, and Dimension
nodes.description: Linear independence of vectors, spanning sets, defining a basis, and the dimension of a vector space.

nodes.name: The Four Fundamental Subspaces
nodes.description: Column space, null space, row space, and left null space, and their dimensions.

nodes.name: Orthogonal Vectors and Subspaces
nodes.description: Orthogonality of the four fundamental subspaces, orthogonal complements.

nodes.name: Projections onto Subspaces
nodes.description: Projection matrices and projecting vectors onto lines or general subspaces.

nodes.name: Least Squares Approximations
nodes.description: Solving overdetermined systems using normal equations and finding the best fit line.

nodes.name: Orthogonal Bases and Gram-Schmidt
nodes.description: Orthonormal vectors, orthogonal matrices, and the Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization process.

nodes.name: Properties of Determinants
nodes.description: The fundamental properties that define the determinant of a square matrix.

nodes.name: Formulas and Cofactors
nodes.description: Computing determinants using the permutation formula and cofactor expansions.

nodes.name: Cramer's Rule and Volumes
nodes.description: Using determinants to find inverses, solving systems with Cramer's Rule, and volume interpretations.

nodes.name: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
nodes.description: Definition of eigenvalues and eigenvectors, and finding them using characteristic equations.

nodes.name: Diagonalization
nodes.description: Diagonalizing a matrix using its eigenvectors, computing powers of matrices.

nodes.name: Systems of Differential Equations
nodes.description: Solving linear systems of differential equations using eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

nodes.name: Symmetric Matrices
nodes.description: Properties of symmetric matrices, including real eigenvalues and orthogonal eigenvectors.

nodes.name: Positive Definite Matrices
nodes.description: Tests for positive definite matrices and their applications.

nodes.name: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)
nodes.description: Factoring any matrix into orthogonal and diagonal matrices.

nodes.name: Linear Transformations
nodes.description: Maps between vector spaces that preserve addition and scalar multiplication, characterised by their action on a basis and represented by matrices.

nodes.name: The Matrix of a Linear Transformation
nodes.description: Representing linear transformations with matrices and changing basis.
